Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Akhilesh Srivastava, learned counsel appearing for Lucknow Development Authority.

By means of this petition, the petitioner claims following reliefs:-
"Issuance of a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the opposite parties particularly to opposite party no. 3 to pay 15 percent statutory Smt. Chhoti Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief ... on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149375247/
1 interest per annum as per the provisions of section 34 of Land Acquisition Act 1894 to the petitioner on awarded compensation from the date of compulsory award till actual date of payment of compensation i.e. 21-10-2008 to 20-10-2023."

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The case of the petitioner is that the award was declared on 21.10.2008 in respect of his land, which was acquired under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, but the compensation was actually paid only on 20.10.2023, hence he claims interest in terms of Section 34 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
The contention is that while making a reference for deciding a title dispute and apportionment of share of compensation under Sections 30 and 31 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894, the compensation amount was not deposited in the Court where the reference was made and the amount remained with the Special Land Acquisition Officer, therefore, the interest under Section 34 of the Act is payable.
The application claiming interest have been submitted on 20.01.2024 which is said to be pending before the Collector/Special Land Acquisition Officer.
Let that application be decided by the Collector/Special Land Acquisition Officer, Lucknow, as the case may be, positively within two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before him, by means of a reasoned and speaking order, unless there is a legal impediment in which case the same shall be informed to the petitioner in writing.
With the aforesaid observations/directions, the writ petition is disposed of.
[Om Prakash Shukla,J.] [Rajan Roy,J.]
